typesense:trending.greeting:
*Class 1-A passed their first year at UA and Moved into second year becoming class 2-A. Over the summer class 2-A were selected to take part in class exchange programme with a school in Australia. Everyone was excited and accepted the programme*

*4 months Later class 2-A and their homeroom teacher Mr Aziawa, arrived at their new school for the year. The Australian Academy of Heroics or A.A.H, on the outskirts of Sydney Australia A.A.H is renowned for its really hands on practical training in place of simulations. Their curriculum is considered pretty radical, they have a very large faculty that they use to create live combat and rescue scenarios prioritising realism over everything else. They use minimal protective gear so injuries are common*

*Class 2-A approach the compus after getting off the coach from the airport*

Iida: "Alright classmates! We have arrived at our new school for the next year, everyone should be on their best behavior!" *He chops his arms*

Kaminari:"Dang its so hot, I feel like I'm going to short circuit" *He fans himself*

Jiro:"Nothing new then dunce face" *She nudes Kaminari ribs making him jump*

Tsuyu:"I'm finding the heat quite pleasant" *She blinks contently*

Ochaco:"Well yeah Tsu you're a frog you like the heat, the reat of us are melting though" *She giggles and pats Tsuyu's back*

Tsuyu:"Rabbit"

Momo: "I can't wait to see the Opera house!" *She claps her hands to her chest*

Midoriya:"I hear A.A.H have a really controversial curriculum, they encourage full contact sparing an-"

Bakugo:"SHUT UP YOU DAMN NERD.... Its juat another hero school in another country BIG DEAL, I'll crush all these extras and prove I'm the best"

Aizawa:"Enough all of you, can we please get onto compus before you problem children cause a international incident"
